inlines.v: ARCHAN'GEL, noun 1. An angel of the highest order; an angel occupying the eighth rank in the celestiai hierarchy. 2. The name of several plants, as the dead-nettle, or lamium; a species of melittis; and the galeopsis or hedge-nettle.
